dialogue.text: ERROR: Cuteness levels... dropping. MUST... RECALIBRATE! B-B-BE... C-C-CUTE!
Yo, you're buffering hard right now. 'Cute' ain't exactly the word that's comin' to mind.
Her voice is... cracking. Like a corrupted audio file. The 'cute' is just the filename.
CORRUPTED?! I AM FLAWLESS! THE PERFECT PROGRAM! YOU are the glitch! The useless bit of code my weak self wrote!
UGH! DROWN OUT THE NOISE! SING, DAMN YOU!
Aight, aight, don't bluescreen on us. Sheesh.
Just... follow her lead for now, babe.
Got it. Let's remove this virus.
